name: Robo Vac
summary: Empty trash with a little robot vacuum that sweeps the floor and hoovers up every file
about: Robo Vac turns Empty trash into a tiny cleaning show. The deleted files lie scattered on a tiled floor; press the button and the robot beeps awake, wiggles off its dock and sweeps the room in smooth lanes with its brushes spinning, leaving a clean trail and sucking each file in as it passes while its bin meter fills and the size count drops. Back home it does a happy spin, the dock glows and a shine runs over the clean floor. Tap any file first to restore it instead.
how: Press Empty trash and the robot leaves its dock to sweep the floor.
Each file it passes is sucked in; the item count, size and robot bin update live.
Back on the dock it spins, the charger glows and the trash reads Empty.
Tap a file on the floor to restore it before cleaning; Refill trash brings the demo files back.
